prompt: In Monopoly, rolling a double lets you roll again, but rolling a double three times in a row on the same turn sends you somewhere instead of moving a third time. Where do you go?

options.text: Nowhere - you just lose the extra roll

explanation: Under Monopoly rules, a third consecutive double on the same turn means you go directly to Jail and do not take the third move.
